title: Go Profiling Plan
description: A structured plan naming the symptom, chosen pprof profile type, load conditions, and exposure settings for a Go profiling session, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/go_pprof_profiling_audit.mjs.

symptom.description: The observed performance pathology driving this session.

profileType.description: The pprof profile (or runtime/trace) chosen to diagnose the symptom.

underRepresentativeLoad.description: True if the capture happens during realistic traffic (peak hour or a load test spanning the capture window), not startup or idle.

pprofBindAddress.description: Where the net/http/pprof endpoints are bound.

environment.description: Which environment the profiling session runs in.

blockMutexSampleRate.description: The SetBlockProfileRate / SetMutexProfileFraction value; 1 samples every event, 100 samples 1-in-100.

runsInContainer.description: True if the process runs under a cgroup memory limit (Kubernetes, Docker).

gomemlimitSet.description: True if GOMEMLIMIT (or debug.SetMemoryLimit) is configured for the deployment.

usedCumulativeView.description: True if CPU-profile reading uses top -cum or the flamegraph view rather than leaf self-time top.

contextCancellationPropagated.description: True if spawned goroutines receive a context.Context and select on ctx.Done() so cancellation propagates.
